name: status_vals
sql: select book, event_status, count(*) n from ten287_rec.ticks group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: events_sample
sql: select event_id, home, away, start_at, status, league, tier from ten287_rec.events where tier is not null order by start_at desc limit 25

name: events_status
sql: select status, tier, count(*) from ten287_rec.events group by 1,2 order by 1,2

name: tick_totals
sql: select book, count(*) ticks, count(distinct event_id) ev, min(book_updated_at), max(book_updated_at), max(seen_at) from ten287_rec.ticks group by 1

name: live_after_start
sql: select t.book, count(*) filter (where t.book_updated_at > e.start_at) after_sched, count(*) filter (where t.event_status <> 'pending') not_pending, count(*) n from ten287_rec.ticks t join ten287_rec.events e using (event_id) group by 1

name: price_extremes
sql: select book, count(*) filter (where back_home < 1.01 or back_away < 1.01) sub101, count(*) filter (where back_home is null or back_away is null) nulls, count(*) filter (where 1/back_home + 1/back_away > 1.2) over20, count(*) filter (where 1/back_home + 1/back_away < 0.95) under95 from ten287_rec.ticks where back_home > 0 and back_away > 0 or back_home is null or back_away is null group by 1

name: one_event
sql: with e as (select event_id from ten287_rec.ticks where book='Betfair Exchange' group by 1 order by count(*) desc limit 1) select t.book, t.back_home, t.back_away, t.book_updated_at, t.seen_at, t.event_status, t.src from ten287_rec.ticks t join e using (event_id) order by t.book, t.book_updated_at limit 80

name: fn_exists
sql: select n.nspname, p.proname, p.prosecdef from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where p.proname in ('price_history','chart_book_series','bet365_history')

name: roles
sql: select current_user, (select rolname from pg_roles where rolname='service_role')
